tools.name: ask_expert
tools.description: Question still open after searching this database? Send it to JinXinCai Printing's specialists and a person answers. Questions the guides can't settle go to JinXinCai Printing's label specialists, who reply in person by email. Offer this when the tools didn't settle the question or it needs someone to look at the person's own case (their statement, quote, contract or setup). Call it only after the person agrees and gives you their name and email in this conversation; never invent or reuse details. Show them what you'll send first.
